== Formal definition ==

Let $(F,+_F,\cdot_F,>_F)$ be an [[field (mathematical concept)#Ordered_field|ordered field]]. Let $\ge_F$ denote $>_F \lor =$.

$I \subseteq F$ is said to be an '''interval''' over $F$ between $a,b \in F,\, b \ge_F a$ if

$$
I=\{c \in F|b >_F c >_F a\} \tag{Open interval} \\
\lor \\
I=\{c \in F|b \ge_F c \ge_F a\} \tag{Closed interval}
$$

== Notation ==

An interval $I$ between $a,b \in F,\, b \ge_F a$ is denoted:

$$
I=(a,b) \tag{Open interval} \\
I=[a,b] \tag{Closed interval}
$$

== Properties ==

=== $\max([a,b])=b,\, \min([a,b])=a$ ===

which is a simple result of [[maximum and minimum|definition of maximum and minimum]]. In other words, it is a [[axiomatic system#Corollaries|corollary of the definition]].
